intro: The Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler is a specialized flask entrusted to novice night elf druids by the Cenarion Circle. It is used to collect a water specimen from the mouth of Cliffspring River cave in Darkshore to help diagnose a foul poison corrupting the local wildlife.

p: Cliffspring Falls provides the principal freshwater source for northern Darkshore, making any disturbance to its headwaters a mortal danger to the local ecosystem. When the native deer population began succumbing to a virulent wasting poison, Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle provided these empty samplers to young druids sent out from Moonglade. Druids must venture deep into the cliffs near the falls, right to the entrance of a cave now overrun by hostile naga, to scoop up a viable water sample.
